topic: How one Oman retail company cut payroll prep from three days to two hours after switching to WPS-integrated payroll
format: Tight case study: company profile, problem, what changed, the one number that proves it worked
post:
A retail company in Oman with 60 staff was spending three full days on payroll every month.

Not because their team was slow. They were manually cross-checking timesheets, calculating deductions, formatting bank transfer files, then chasing approvals over WhatsApp before anything reached the bank.

One wrong cell in a spreadsheet meant starting from scratch.

They moved to SmartPRO Hub. WPS payroll with direct bank integration, automated deduction logic, one-click submission.

Payroll prep went from three days to two hours.

Same team. Same 60 employees. No spreadsheets in the middle.

SmartPRO Hub is built for exactly this — not a workaround bolted onto generic HR software, but a system wired to local bank submission requirements and Ministry of Labour compliance from the start.

The ops director's words after their first cycle: "We didn't realise how much time we were just losing."

If your payroll process still runs on a shared Excel file and a lot of manual checking, that's worth fixing.
